name: Combined_drought_salinity
title: How Do Plants Respond to Combined Drought and Salinity Stress?—A Systematic Review
authors: Angon, Prodipto Bishnu, Tahjib-Ul-Arif, Md., Samin, Samia Islam, Habiba, Ummya, Hossain, M. Afzal
abstract: <jats:p>Plants are frequently exposed to one or more abiotic stresses, including combined salinity-drought, which significantly lowers plant growth. Many studies have been conducted to evaluate the responses of plants to combined salinity and drought stress. However, a meta-analysis-based systematic review has not been conducted yet.
